title: Quality of Life(DC)
description: Adds some quality of life features to improve our gaming experience!
body:
This datapack is for minecraft 1.21.11.

## Current Features:
- Diffrent sized entitys including players
- Spectral arrows glow when shot from a bow or crossbow
- **More to come soon!**

Made by LunaKat and Mineosaur of the Data Circuit!
